payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is at least one frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl?
node.criteria: complete: at least one frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl, within its rim; additional frogs elsewhere do not reduce completion. partial: a frog is present but none is clearly inside the bowl, such as frogs only on the lid or floor, or placement is only partly inside. absent: no frog has been added. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine whether any frog is inside the bowl.
node.binding: The frog(s) added in relation to the toilet; assess their visible placement relative to the toilet bowl.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"A frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl, within the rim. Other frogs are on the lid and floor, but do not affect completion.","confidence":0.99}
